The [[Deldrimor Focus]] was introduced in the [[Game updates/20080424|April 24, 2008 game update]] and is part of the Deldrimor set. It is available for any caster attribute. It is inscribable.

==Acquisition==
Crafted by [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]] for: 10 {{plat}}, 10 {{Deldrimor Steel}}, and 10 {{steel}}.

== Stats ==
:Energy +12 (requires 9 <[[attribute]]>)
:[[Inscription]]: None

==Dye==
[[Dye]] affects the metallic patterning on the handle of the vessel, with most of it obscured by the wielder's hand. The default color can be closely replicated with brown dye.
{{dye chart}}

==Notes==
* Other items with this appearance:
**{{any}} [[Deldrimor Focus (unique)]]

== Trivia ==
* This item, along with the [[Diessa Icon]], is one of only two Prophecies focus items linked to [[Smiting Prayers]]. It is the only such item with maximum stats.
* It resembles an ale mug.
